invariants.title: The dust clears
invariants.rule: The cloud arrives, then thins - by the end his face is clear.
invariants.why: Measured: LTX lets an effect accumulate whatever the words say; H3 plateaus and clears. That is why this shot is H3.

invariants.title: The camera is still
invariants.why: The dust is the only thing moving; a camera move would muddy it.

title: the dust
beat: The dust rolls over Hale and thins. He lowers his arm and squints through it.
